message: Yeah, I was wondering why I was "Ratliff" all of a sudden. In light of this post, I thought I'd mention one thing to you; I'm guessing you'll appreciate hearing it. At the beginning of your presentation (and this might have been intentional, so tell me if it was), you were talking about something -- I forget what exactly -- and you said, "and someone who has read his Derrida..." Anyway, not that big a deal, but coming from you especially, it sort of stuck in my mind.
